summary: A two-station restroom trailer is about 10 to 16 ft long, 6 to 10 ft wide and 8 to 11 ft tall, and serves roughly 75 to 150 guests. Bigger trailers have up to 10 or 12 stations; accessible (ADA) trailers have ramps, wider doors and lower sinks and must be asked for.
